name: rtk (Rust Token Killer)
description: Installs rtk, a CLI tool that compresses command outputs before they reach the AI context window. Reduces token usage by 60-90% with zero config changes. Optionally runs rtk init to activate the auto-rewrite hook for a specific AI agent.

version.description: rtk version to install. 'latest' installs the newest release. Otherwise a published version such as '0.45.0' (a leading 'v' is stripped).

agent.description: AI agent to configure rtk for at build time via 'rtk init --global'. Empty skips init (run it manually later). Supported agents: opencode, claude-code, cursor, aider, gemini-cli, codex, windsurf, cline, copilot.
